lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hi, Hyunju! You sound happy today. Did something good happen?
lines.ko: 현주야! 오늘 목소리가 밝다. 좋은 일 있었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Finally, I made a workbook for the NCS.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, congratulations! But what is the NCS? Can you tell me about it?
lines.ko: 와, 축하해! 그런데 NCS가 뭐야? 설명해 줄 수 있어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: The NCS is a test for getting a job in Korea.
lines.ko: NCS는 한국에서 취업할 때 보는 시험이야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Oh, I see! That sounds like a lot of work. Who is the workbook for?
lines.ko: 아, 그렇구나! 정말 손이 많이 갔겠다. 그 문제집은 누구를 위한 거야?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It's for me. These days, I've been stressed at work, so I'd like to find another job. I'd like to work in planning.
lines.ko: 나를 위한 거야. 요즘 회사에서 계속 스트레스를 받아서 이직하고 싶어. 기획 쪽 일을 하고 싶어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Planning? That's perfect for you! You're so good at making plans. Look at your English study! When is the test?
lines.ko: 기획? 너한테 딱이다! 너 계획 세우는 거 정말 잘하잖아. 영어 공부하는 것만 봐도! 시험은 언제야?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'm planning to take the test in March twenty twenty-seven. This May, I got eight hundred fifteen points on the TOEIC. Now I'm starting to study the other parts.
lines.ko: 2027년 3월에 시험을 볼 계획이야. 올해 5월에 토익 815점을 받았어. 이제 다른 과목 공부를 시작하는 중이야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, eight hundred fifteen on the TOEIC? That's a great score! Which part is the hardest for you?
lines.ko: 와, 토익 815점? 정말 좋은 점수다! 어떤 과목이 제일 어려워?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: The hardest part is math. When I was young, I always had trouble with math, so I'm very worried.
lines.ko: 제일 어려운 건 수학이야. 어릴 때부터 수학이 늘 어려웠거든. 그래서 정말 걱정돼.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Don't worry. You made a whole workbook! You can do it. How are you going to study math?
lines.ko: 걱정 마. 문제집을 통째로 만들었잖아! 넌 할 수 있어. 수학은 어떻게 공부할 거야?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'm planning to study math step by step. If there is something I can't understand, I'll ask again and again.
lines.ko: 수학은 차근차근 공부할 계획이야. 이해가 안 되는 게 있으면 몇 번이고 다시 물어볼 거야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: That's a great plan! And if you need help, you can ask me, too. Good luck with the test, Hyunju. Good night!
lines.ko: 좋은 계획이다! 도움 필요하면 나한테도 물어봐. 시험 잘 봐, 현주야. 잘 자!

vocab.example: Finally, I made a workbook for the NCS.
I'm planning to take the test in March.
These days, I've been stressed at work.

vocab.meaning: 기획 일을 하다 (planning part는 한국식 표현)

vocab.example: I'm planning to study math step by step.

vocab.word: If there is something I can't ~
vocab.example: If there is something I can't understand, I'll ask again.
